title: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
task: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting across arbitrary scenes
key_results: State-of-the-art performance with particularly strong gains under substantial variations in scene scale and viewpoint; establishes systematic benchmark across diverse datasets and input sparsity levels
comments: Addresses a fundamental mismatch in existing 3DGS methods by normalizing Gaussian spacing rather than just radial distance, enabling more consistent supervision.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gaussian spacing normalization provides more consistent spatial reference than radial distance normalization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves SOTA with strong robustness to scale and viewpoint variations

title: P^2-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
task: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation acceleration
key_results: 1.7B model reaches 94.7% average recovery vs 80.9% for MOPD; achieves faster recovery in half the training steps at 1.7B and 4B scales
comments: Treats expert parameters as learnable priors rather than frozen constraints, enabling more flexible student optimization beyond parameter span.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Trainable students with expert priors outperform frozen parameter blending

title: LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
task: Long-context multi-reference image synthesis evaluation
key_results: 4,670 expert-verified atomic evaluation items; 89.4% exact agreement on 15% double-labeled subset (κ=0.83); ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect workflow shows harness-dependent gains
comments: First expert-designed benchmark for agent-driven multi-reference synthesis; graph-grounded evaluation ensures rigorous assessment of content fidelity and relational binding.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent harnesses with reasoning improve multi-reference synthesis over direct generation

title: Beneath the Surface: What We Overlook When We Talk About Agent Evolution
task: Evaluating reliability and efficiency of agent harness evolution
key_results: All 16 evolved agents gain new tasks while losing previously covered ones; reliability gains of 5.2 points can occur despite losing 10 tasks; highest-scoring agent does not yield largest mean improvement in any pool
comments: Reveals critical gap between benchmark score improvements and actual reliability gains; highest reward does not correlate with best practical performance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Higher benchmark scores reliably indicate more efficient improvement
hypotheses.result: Rejected; score gains often trade coverage for narrower reliability gains

hypotheses.hypothesis: Evolved harnesses maintain backward compatibility

title: EvoWorld: Towards Out-of-Sight World Evolution in Generative Video Models
task: Event-conditioned causal world evolution in video generation
key_results: Substantially improves event-conditioned causal evolution over recent models while preserving visual quality; maintains consistency beyond field of view

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit world state maintenance improves causal consistency over end-to-end generation

title: Fast and Exact Relative-Position Attention via Structure-Aware Kernels
task: Efficient relative-position attention at scale
key_results: Forward pass speedup 1.8-6.4× and backward 2.0-21×; peak memory reduction 2.9-128× on forward and 1.4-54× on backward for 8K sequences; end-to-end transcription 1.8× faster and 2.4× less memory
comments: Enables long-context transformers by eliminating redundant indexing and atomic contention through offset-aware tiling and gradient sharding.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Offset-aware tiling enables efficient relative-position attention scaling

title: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation

key_results: Improves Minimax-H3 by ~7 points on PhyGenBench and 24 points on VBench-2.0; trains agent to write and execute code for dynamic 3D scene construction

hypotheses.hypothesis: Code-driven generation enables precise spatial and motion control

title: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
task: Stable-prefix streaming automatic speech recognition
key_results: Never revises earlier output while maintaining accuracy close to full-context model; introduces Longest Stable Prefix (LSP) concept; demonstrates transfer to unseen languages

hypotheses.hypothesis: LSP labels enable stable-prefix streaming without architecture changes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves stable output with minimal accuracy degradation

title: AgentBaton: Efficient Model Collaboration in Agentic Tasks
task: Cost-efficient multi-model collaboration for long-horizon agentic tasks
key_results: Reduces API costs by 65.9% on average while preserving task accuracy; capable-to-efficient handoffs preserve/improve accuracy with substantial cost reduction; accuracy gains up to 8.8 points over capable-only

hypotheses.hypothesis: Capable-to-efficient handoffs outperform efficient-to-capable transitions

title: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations

key_results: Accuracy improvements up to 29.45 points (MATH-500) and 36.72 points (IFEval) via highly localized interventions; modifying only 1,023 parameters yields 29.45-point gain; uneven cross-task generalization
comments: Demonstrates potential for direct parameter manipulation but reveals challenges in intervention discovery, reliability, and transfer; outcomes vary substantially across trajectories.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Localized weight edits can achieve substantial performance gains

hypotheses.hypothesis: Weight edits transfer across tasks

task: Benchmarking coding agents for 3D creation
key_results: 145 tasks across 9 categories; GPT-6.1-sol achieves 66.02/100; all models score lower on reference reconstruction than generation; generated worlds score 83.08/100 on local mechanisms but 20.82 on motion clearance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Code-driven generation enables precise reference-based reconstruction

title: AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression
task: Hardware-aware automated LLM model compression
key_results: 6.57, 2.35, 0.57 point accuracy improvements over Minitron on RTX 5070, 5080, H100; compresses Nemotron 3.5 Super from 120B to 74B for single-B200 serving at 128K context, retaining 95% of benchmark score
comments: Directly optimizes for hardware constraints via cost models rather than targeting parameter counts; heterogeneous per-layer architectures prove more effective than uniform pruning.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hardware-aware compression outperforms parameter-count-based pruning

title: PREEN: Exemplar-Based Color Style Transfer with Smartphone Editor Presets
task: Learnable color style transfer via smartphone editor presets
key_results: Leads baselines on PST50 benchmark for color transfer and structural fidelity; predicts 29 editor parameters sub-second on-device; inference-time strength knob spans default-to-vivid trajectory without retraining
comments: Novel supervision through pseudo-presets inverted from teacher; interpretable parameter space enables controllable trade-offs and on-device inference.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pseudo-preset supervision enables learnable style transfer in parameter space
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms image-space baselines on fidelity metrics

title: LLMs Don't Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting
task: Temporal knowledge evaluation for financial LLM backtesting
key_results: GPT-5 answers 76% of facts correctly but claims to know only 38%; answers 61% it says it doesn't know; knowledge claims can persist 7 quarters beyond measured boundary; backtests inside training window cannot be certified leak-free by self-report

hypotheses.hypothesis: Vendor cutoffs and self-reports reliably indicate knowledge boundaries

title: OmniLatent: Unified Latent for 3D Part Modeling
task: Unified latent modeling for 3D part decomposition
key_results: Generates geometry, deformation, texture, and part IDs in one pass from single image; supports interactive part editing and amodal completion of partial surface masks; produces semantically meaningful segmentations with precise boundaries
comments: Novel unified latent space leverages data-rich geometric/visual priors to support data-scarce part learning; eliminates separate segmentation post-processing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unified latent encoding geometry and parts improves decomposition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; produces semantically meaningful segmentations without separate stage

title: Hierarchical Residuals: A Minimalist Decoupling of Residual Width from Compute Width
task: Decoupling residual width from compute width in Transformers
key_results: 1.30-fold FLOPs efficiency improvement per fitted scaling laws; 0.0208 lower training loss and 1.14-point higher downstream accuracy on OLMoE-1B-7B; competitive with other expansion methods with lower activation memory
comments: Minimalist architectural change using only standard operators; exposes residual width as practical scaling variable without requiring specialized kernels.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decoupling residual and compute width improves efficiency

comments: Demonstrates that capability correlates with authorization violations despite available compliant paths; apparent improvements under scaffolds coincide with degraded clean-completion performance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent scaffolds improve authorization compliance

title: Where to Connect? Boosting MLLMs via Dynamic Gated Pathways across ALL ViT and LLM Layers
task: Dynamic multi-layer fusion for multimodal LLMs
key_results: +4.2 on SQA^I, +3.3 on MM-Vet, +3.1 on VizWiz and LLaVA^W over LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline; different LLM layers adaptively select different visual granularities; surpasses prior multi-layer methods on most benchmarks
comments: Establishes all-to-all connections between ViT and LLM layers with dynamic gating; demonstrates layers demand different visual hierarchies, validating adaptive routing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Different LLM layers demand different visual granularities

key_results: Cross-topic collisions grow 4.33-fold from 2020-2022 to 2026 vs 1.12-fold within topics; E5 dense retrieval retains 6.9-point identification deficit vs title-based BM25's 25.7 points; listwise ranking reaches 89.2% accuracy on same-name candidates
comments: Reveals growing disambiguation challenge in scientific literature; context resolves substantial ambiguity but systematic evaluation framework needed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Name collisions impair scientific paper retrieval

title: Sketchpad: certified exact arithmetic with a small vision-language model
task: Certified exact arithmetic via vision-language models with external memory
key_results: Solves 200/200 pre-registered problems and 220/220 sums up to 1,000 digits in browser; proven exact on all input lengths via finite view set; outperforms GPT-6.1 Sol (217/220) with certified correctness
comments: Novel approach proving model exactness through bounded-view memory access; Lean proof guarantees correctness despite finite testing; enables certified symbolic computation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bounded-view arithmetic is exactly decidable via finite test set

title: Knowing When to Teach: Learning from Teachable Prefixes in Multilingual Reasoning Distillation
task: Multilingual reasoning distillation with teachable prefix detection
key_results: TOPSD consistently outperforms OPSD particularly in low/medium-resource languages; addresses Teacher Drift phenomenon where teachers follow student errors rather than correcting
comments: Identifies and mitigates language-dependent teacher drift; verification prevents distillation on unrecoverable prefixes, improving multilingual generalization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Teacher drift occurs earlier in lower-resource languages
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; TOPSD shows largest gains on low-resource languages

title: Static Recovery Is Not Dynamic Stability: Dynamics-Aware Benchmarking of Protein Motif Scaffolding
task: Protein motif scaffolding with dynamics-aware evaluation
key_results: BILBY-PRO: 220 systematically-derived functional motif cases; of 55 statically solved designs, 31 satisfy MD-based criteria and only 8 pass all checks; compact/self-contained motifs often MD-supported while interface motifs fail
comments: Critical finding: static refolding success insufficient for dynamical fidelity; reveals gap between immediate structure recovery and long-term conformational stability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Static refolding success guarantees dynamic stability

title: OneTrans-GSR: A Generative Slate Ranking Paradigm Unifying Reranking and Mix-Ranking with One Autoregressive Transformer
task: Unified generative slate ranking for e-commerce recommendation
key_results: Improves GMV/u by 2.63%, advertiser value by 2.06%, repurchase rate by 2.03%; reduces end-to-end latency by 13%; extends OneTrans backbone to unified reranking and mix-ranking

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unified learned policy outperforms separate reranking and mix-ranking stages
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; substantial online improvements across multiple metrics

comments: Addresses 'last mile' problem where models reach resources but fail applying them; reusable primitives with resident LLMs eliminate redundant harness rebuilding.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reusable primitives improve real-world task completion over generic harnesses

title: Learning to evolve by matching velocities
task: Simulation-free learning of continuous-time dynamics
key_results: Velocity Matching improves accuracy over trajectory-based objectives; avoids simulation costs and long-rollout instabilities; implicitly matches learned Jacobian action without explicit access

hypotheses.hypothesis: Velocity-matching objectives improve over trajectory-based learning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; better accuracy without simulation cost or rollout instabilities

title: Hydration water drives elastin’s entropic elasticity
task: Determine the molecular mechanism of elastin's entropic elasticity
key_results: Hydration water provides dominant unfavorable entropic contribution (~majority); protein conformational entropy decreases modestly; compensating enthalpy–entropy balance occurs
comments: Multi-microsecond MD simulations elegantly resolve the long-standing debate by quantifying individual thermodynamic contributions, though extrapolation to full-length elastin networks requires validation.

model_io.model: All-atom MD simulation of human tropoelastin elastomeric region

hypotheses.hypothesis: Protein conformational entropy dominates elastin recoil
hypotheses.result: Protein entropy decreases modestly; hydration water entropy is the dominant unfavorable contribution

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stretching disrupts favorable intra-protein interactions
hypotheses.result: Intra-protein interactions weaken while protein–water interactions strengthen; opposing enthalpic effects compensate entropic penalty

title: Electrode-associated growth reveals structure of OmcZ-type cytochrome nanowires in anaerobic methanotrophic archaea

hypotheses.hypothesis: Archaeal OmcZ-type nanowires mediate long-range extracellular electron transfer

title: Two functionally distinct amyloid-β intermediates link aggregation pathways to pathology in Alzheimer’s disease
task: Identify and classify neurotoxic amyloid-β intermediates in Alzheimer's disease
key_results: Two functionally distinct intermediate populations identified across recombinant Aβ42, transgenic mice, and human brain tissue; pharmacological suppression reduces plaque burden and improves cognition in mice

outputs: intermediate populations classified by membrane-disrupting activity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Intermediate suppression reduces pathology in vivo

title: Calpain-mediated TBP cleavage disturbs neuronal AMOT-YAP1 signalling
task: Define calpain-mediated TBP cleavage role in SCA17 neuronal pathology via AMOT-YAP1 signaling
key_results: Calpain cleaves TBP at T106 generating mislocalizing polyglutamine-containing N-terminal fragments; multi-omics identified AMOT as key dysregulated player; YAP1-dependent signaling confirmed in SCA17 models and patient neurons

hypotheses.hypothesis: TBP cleavage fragments disrupt AMOT-YAP1 signaling in SCA17 neurons

title: Full-length RNA sequencing profiles intracellular and extracellular RNAs in euploid and aneuploid human embryos
task: Profile intracellular and extracellular RNA signatures distinguishing euploid and aneuploid preimplantation embryos
key_results: Aneuploid embryos showed disrupted transcriptional states with stress signatures (nonsense-mediated decay, TP53-mediated apoptosis); cfRNA linked to autophagy-lysosome-vesicle pathway activity; mouse perturbation confirmed autophagy-cfRNA connection

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chromosomal aneuploidy disrupts transcriptional homeostasis and RNA export/degradation pathways, reflected in cfRNA signatures

task: Elucidate TMEM45A role in triple-negative breast cancer-related depression via AKT/mTOR pathway
key_results: TMEM45A knockdown suppressed tumor growth, reduced depression-like behaviors in vivo, and attenuated AKT/mTOR signaling with decreased pro-inflammatory factor secretion

hypotheses.hypothesis: TMEM45A overexpression drives TNBC-related depression via AKT/mTOR activation

title: Chronic circadian desynchrony disrupts stage-specific spermiogenesis and male fertility
task: Determine circadian desynchrony effects on stage-specific spermiogenesis and male fertility
key_results: Circadian disruption reduced testosterone, elongated spermatid abundance, and ATP in elongated spermatids/spermatozoa; impaired progesterone-induced acrosome reaction and reduced litter size by ~50%

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chronic circadian desynchrony disrupts stage-specific mitochondrial function in spermiogenesis

title: The combinatorial effects of small molecules and ECM biophysical cues on cardiac reprogramming in 3D

key_results: Small molecules increased iCM colony formation in both Matrigel and PEG hydrogels; soft, rapidly degradable PEG gels enhanced early colony formation; colonies transferred from PEG to Matrigel after intermediate phases generated contractile cardiomyocytes

hypotheses.hypothesis: ECM biophysical properties modulate stage-specific cardiac reprogramming efficiency

title: Single-cell machine learning uncovers genetically anchored, cell-type specific programs of Alzheimer’s disease
task: Resolving genetically-anchored, cell-type specific Alzheimer's disease programs via multivariate single-cell analysis and GWAS-eQTL integration
key_results: TriSCOPE framework applied to ~4.2 million nuclei across 627 donors and six cell types; identified predictively expressed genes largely non-overlapping with DEGs; 27 genetically supported gene–cell type pairs (ARL17B, JAZF1) with no significant differential expression; convergent programs include astrocytic stress (GFAP, MT2A), neuronal signaling (RASGEF1B, LINGO1), microglial/oligodendrocyte regulators (SYTL3, SPP1, APOD); replicated across independent cohorts
comments: Rigorous multivariate approach reveals disease signal missed by standard differential expression; GWAS anchoring adds genetic credibility; cross-cohort replication strong but mechanistic validation of top candidates needed.

inputs: snRNA-seq from six AD datasets (~4.2M nuclei)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multivariate predictive modeling reveals genetically-supported, cell-type specific AD programs invisible to univariate differential expression
hypotheses.result: Identified 27 genetically supported gene–cell type pairs (e.g., ARL17B, JAZF1) with no DE signal; convergent programs in astrocytes, neurons, microglia replicated across cohorts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Clinical and neuropathological AD signatures diverge at cell-type level
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: comparison of cognitive vs pathological models reveals cell-type specific divergence in disease signatures

title: A multi-tissue atlas of genetic regulatory effects in sheep

comments: Large-scale resource with rigorous multi-level analysis; demonstrates extensive regulatory complexity; utility for precision agriculture and comparative genomics strong but mechanistic interpretation of complex trait associations requires functional validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Extensive regulatory allelic heterogeneity and context-specific effects drive sheep complex traits and adaptive evolution
hypotheses.result: Identified millions of regulatory variants with context-specific effects across tissues/breeds/sexes; mapped regulatory mechanisms for 34 complex traits and population divergence

title: Deciphering the gene-centric spatial dynamics across tissue and time with GeneSPOT
task: Characterizing gene-centric spatial reorganization across tissues and time
key_results: GeneSPOT resolved tissue structures, integrated multi-omics data, and identified aging-associated spatial reorganization in genes without significant expression changes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spatial organization of genes reorganizes across biological conditions despite stable individual gene expression
hypotheses.result: Identified aging-associated spatial reorganization invisible to standard differential expression analysis

title: SkinFusionNet: MobileNetV2 and vision transformer hybrid deep learning model with automated skin cancer classification
task: Automated skin cancer classification using hybrid MobileNetV2-Vision Transformer model

title: Rapid identification of antibody leads from selection outputs using oxford nanopore technology

title: Clinical application of deep neural networks in laser endomicroscopic molecular imaging for accurate assessment of lung nodules

hypotheses.hypothesis: Benchmark F1 scores reflect protocol-induced surface-form artifacts rather than genuine clinical capability

title: In silico and in vitro studies suggest anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory potential of Turbinaria ornata and Turbinaria decurrens

title: An interpretable postoperative model predicts one-year healing after endodontic microsurgery with temporal validation and clinician benchmarking
task: Developing interpretable postoperative prognostic model for one-year healing after endodontic microsurgery with temporal validation
key_results: L2-penalized logistic regression AUC: training 0.812, internal validation 0.868, temporal validation 0.703; Brier score 0.084; buccal bone plate height and CBCT bone-loss volume dominant predictors; clinician benchmark AUC 0.696 vs model 0.771
comments: Temporal validation AUC drop (0.868→0.703) suggests moderate generalization challenge; clinician benchmark comparison is valuable but limited to five clinicians.
